# ALVStore

> Udaipur's audio-visual, home theater, pro cafe & lounge sound, 4K laser projection, RGBW architectural lighting & Zigbee 3.0 smart automation studio (established 2009).

ALVStore designs, supplies, installs, and calibrates residential private cinemas, hi-fi & commercial speaker systems, 4K laser projection setups, hospitality audio/PA systems, and RGBW Zigbee 3.0 lighting control across Udaipur, Rajasthan (Hiran Magri, Fatehpura, Shobhagpura, Bhuwana, Fatehsagar, Rani Road, Lake Pichola, Saheli Marg, Nathdwara, Kumbhalgarh, Chittorgarh, Mount Abu) and pan-India.

Showroom & Engineering Studio: Shop No. 2, 229, Alok School Road, Sector 11, Hiran Magri, Udaipur, Rajasthan 313001 · +91 98876 01200 · sales@alvstore.in · Mon–Sat 10:00–20:00 IST.

## Core Pages & Udaipur Pillars

- [ALVStore Studio Gallery](https://alvstore.com/): Flagship showcase, interactive Spatial Room Planner (5.1 to 7.2.4 Dolby Atmos), and consultation intake.
- [Best Home Theater Installation in Udaipur](https://alvstore.com/home-theater-udaipur): Custom Dolby Atmos theaters, marble/Kota stone reflection treatment, Dirac Live & Audyssey XT32 calibration, Denon, Marantz, JBL Synthesis, KEF, Bowers & Wilkins.
- [Best Speakers & Sound Systems in Udaipur](https://alvstore.com/speakers-udaipur): Floorstanding towers, in-wall/in-ceiling architectural speakers, subwoofers, IP65 weatherproof terrace speakers, and high-SPL PA cabinets.
- [4K Laser Projectors & Screens in Udaipur](https://alvstore.com/projectors-udaipur): Sony SXRD & JVC D-ILA native 4K laser projection, UST Laser TVs, motorized tensioned ALR screens, 120"–220" woven acoustically transparent screens, and optical servicing.
- [Cafe & Lounge Commercial Sound & PA Systems in Udaipur](https://alvstore.com/commercial-audio-lounge-cafe-udaipur): Multi-zone 70V/100V background music networks, IP65 rooftop weatherproof audio, club subwoofers, noise-spill directional aiming, echo dampening, and DMX/zone lighting.
- [RGBW Architectural Lighting & Zigbee 3.0 Automation in Udaipur](https://alvstore.com/rgbw-lighting-zigbee-automation-udaipur): 24V high-CRI RGBW/RGBCW cove lighting (2700K–6000K), local self-healing Zigbee mesh hubs, non-invasive heritage switchboard retrofits, glass touch panels, curtain & cinema scene sync.
- [Contact & Consultation](https://alvstore.com/contact): Direct site survey booking, WhatsApp, studio directions, and equipment diagnostics.
